# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure money-manager-import (2026-10-22). Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. # Left out on purpose: # - the 401 for an invalid, expired or revoked upload token (api/deps.py:110-116) # - rate limits on the route (api/money_manager_upload.py:42-43) # - Cancel on the review card and the force re-import of an up-to-date backup (useMoneyManagerImport.ts:151-163) # - the browser's own 4.5 MB body check before posting (services/api/moneyManagerBackup.ts:64-66) # - the 500 for OSError, RuntimeError and SQLAlchemyError (api/money_manager_upload.py:81-85) # - a failed analytics refresh: the ledger stays saved and analytics_status is failed (services/money_manager_import.py:80-85) # - normalization, transfer pairing and soft deletes inside the snapshot path (statement-import.yaml draws them) title: Money Manager backup import subtitle: The server reads the .mmbak itself; a dry run fills the review, and only a confirmed or token upload commits kind: flowchart direction: down

in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:78#_BOUNDED_UPLOAD_PATHS - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:81#UploadSizeLimitMiddleware principal: shape: process label: Identify uploader note: JWT, or lsu_ token in: lane-api # a token forces dry_run and allow_large_delete off (money_manager_upload.py:62-67) evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/deps.py:102-121#get_upload_principal - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_tokens.py:88#authenticate_upload_token - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/money_manager_upload.py:62-67#token_id rej-size: shape: terminator label: "413, ledger unchanged" in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:114-120 read: shape: predefined label: Read backup note: gzip or zip, SQLite checks in: lane-api # gzip or zip (unpack_backup), in-memory defensive query-only SQLite with quick_check (_connect), tables (_check_schema), rows with UIDs (_read_rows) evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:115-135#read_backup - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:138#unpack_backup - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:197-214#_connect - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:223#_check_schema - backend/src/ledger_sync/ingest/money_manager.py:241#_read_rows dup: shape: decision label: Already imported? svg.title: Money Manager backup import
svg.desc: Money Manager backup import. 21 components in 3 groups. Connections: Money Manager backup to iOS Shortcut (on app close); iOS Shortcut to Body within limit?; Choose a .mmbak to Gzip in the browser; Gzip in the browser to POST dry_run=true; POST dry_run=true to Body within limit?; Review card to POST import (confirm); POST import to Body within limit?; Body within limit? to 413, ledger unchanged (no); Body within limit? to Identify uploader (yes); Identify uploader to Read backup; Read backup to 400, ledger unchanged (unreadable); Read backup to Already imported?; Already imported? to 200 unchanged (yes, not forced); Already imported? to Reconcile, source UID first (no); Reconcile, source UID first to Removes > max(25, 5%)?; Removes > max(25, 5%)? to 409, rolled back (yes); Removes > max(25, 5%)? to Dry run? (no); Dry run? to Review card (yes: 200 preview); Dry run? to Commit ledger + import log (no); Commit ledger + import log to Refresh analytics; Refresh analytics to 200 imported.

text.tspan: The server reads the .mmbak itself; a dry run fills the review, and only a confirmed or token upload commits
